No satellite thermal detections were found on this asset between 23 September and 23 October 2026. NASA FIRMS returned zero detections intersecting the asset boundary, and all four sensors (three VIIRS satellites and MODIS) covered every day of the period.

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The result also says nothing about burned area, since the tool did not assess whether any was present or absent. It does not indicate the cause of any change on the property, and it does not cover any time outside the evaluated period.

A fair reading is that no fire was detected by thermal satellites, with full sensor coverage. Confirming that no fire happened would need other evidence, such as burn-scar imagery or ground reports.
